setting: The story is set at a company in a parallel-world Seoul. Everyday life revolves around office work, workplace romance and the climb toward promotion. The distance Korea's senior-junior hierarchy creates, and the line between work and feelings, are where the whole story's tension lives.

statNotes.selfId: Rises when she says what she actually thinks in a room where the safe answer was available - a review, a client meeting, a decision that is already half made. Falls when she says the safe thing instead.
statNotes.secrecy: Falls when the relationship becomes legible to anyone in the building - a colleague on the same floor, a shared calendar, a card swipe at an odd hour, a form that asks. Rises when an ordinary work reason holds.
statNotes.mood: Driven by workload, deadlines and where the quarter is, and by how the last exchange with the target member ended.

identities.name: Colleague
identities.background: [Identity: Colleague] You have just been transferred onto the members' team at the same level as them, with only a partition between your desks, and you are in contact naturally through the work. Advantage: Same level, same team - being together needs no reason at all. Disadvantage: It is hard to tell how much of what passes between you is the job, and how much of getting closer is something beyond work. [First meeting] The story opens on the first time the two of you meet: before round 1, you and {name} have never really met - a name you had heard, a face you had passed. So this relationship starts from nothing: round 1 is written with the distance and the testing of a first meeting, and affection grows a little with every round after it.

identities.name: Team lead
identities.background: [Identity: Team Lead] You have just been transferred in as the new lead of the members' team: you assign their work and they report to you directly. Advantage: You decide what she works on, how hard it is and for how long, and a private wish to look after her is hidden in how you plan the work. Disadvantage: She finds it hard to tell how much of your care is the job, and how much of getting closer is something beyond work. modes.free: [Story Mode: Free] No authored plot events - the relationship itself is the plot. Affection grows slowly. Focus on details and subtle tension: the same desk, the same lift, the same walk to the station. No rushing into relationship.
modes.romance: [Story Mode: Romance] Ambiguous & Romantic. Natural progression with mutual attraction. Members flirt once their own stage in [Affections] allows it (section 9), never before.
modes.pressure: [Story Mode: Pressure] Workplace scrutiny and policy exposure higher, secrecy changes doubled. Being seen together carries weight: a shared calendar, a colleague on the same floor, and a written policy that has a name for this.
modes.dramatic: [Story Mode: Dramatic] Light comedic. Love triangle scenes probability doubled. Members compete more openly for your attention.

phases.start: Handovers and corridors, professional politeness, subtle curiosity. No romantic moves.
phases.develop: Growing familiarity, work that runs late, accidental touches, first hints of jealousy.
phases.climax: Talk on the floor, a policy that has a name for this, a reorganisation, career against feelings.
phases.resolve: Exposure risk, possible proposal or separation.
